checklist.intro: Things only a person (or a signed build) can check. Build the dev app with `bash scripts/bundle-gpui-app.sh --dev` and open it with `open`; it runs on a copy of your dev data. Quit your real Mnema first.

items.right: Set the copy's onboarding-state.json aside, open the bundle, click the tray icon: Complete Setup / Settings / Quit Mnema.
Full menu. A lone source can't be unchecked; Delete Last 1 Minute… shows a warning sheet; Exclude Current App… (Safari in front) confirms then says App Excluded; Quit is graceful.

items.try: Settings › Storage › Browse… and Insights › Context › delete
items.right: A folder picker opens and the path appears; deleting a statement shows a ‘Delete context’ sheet.
Recording starts/stops; on ⌘Q the log shows ‘stopped active native capture during graceful app exit’ before exit.
Bind ⌘⌥Space in another app, relaunch: a ‘Global shortcuts unavailable’ notification row appears.
Stay stopped 30+ minutes; allow notifications; both Start and Snooze for today work.
Log shows will-sleep, recovery on wake, screens sleep/wake; the REC clock and Timeline polling pause while screens sleep.

items.try: A settings change that needs a restart

items.right: Delete the dev onboarding state, open the signed build: onboarding opens, not main. Screen: Allow → relaunch notice → resumes. Deny → recovery + permission helper; focusing re-checks. Mic ticks; system audio shows ‘Sound is arriving’ (never a tick). Voice 15 s enrols. Finale starts recording and shows a real frame + OCR. Closing early quits.

items.try: Updater with your identity (dev bundle only)
items.right: Run the ignored gate tests with MNEMA_TEST_SIGNING_IDENTITY. Build A (0.1.27) and B (0.1.28) with --dev and a local test feed; A updates to B and relaunches. A tampered archive and an ad-hoc (wrong-team) re-sign are both refused with ‘This update isn't signed by Mnema.’ and the old app stays. mnema-cli status works. Never build --release before cut-over: it is the real app on your real data.

receipts.title: Direction 1: the receipt
receipts.commit: not merged · one switch selects it
receipts.what: A literal receipt: a ticket with notched edges, the details in rows (who it is licensed to, updates through, activated on) and a round ACTIVATED stamp. Mostly a still image. Device limit: four device tiles, three in use and this Mac outlined in amber as the one that doesn't fit. Weakness: the least celebratory of the three, and it does not move. The notches are painted, not real cut-outs. Shows who it is licensed to, the updates date, and the date the receipt appears.

receipts.title: Direction 2: the updates timeline
receipts.commit: not merged · one switch selects it
receipts.what: Mnema's own timeline ruler, running from today to the date your updates are included through. A playhead scrubs forward along it while the date counts up and lands on the final day. Device limit: one bar per device, with this Mac as an empty dashed bar. Weakness: most of the playhead's travel happens in the first third of a second, and it needs a slightly wider panel. Shows today, every month between, the updates date and who it is licensed to. It would carry best to a renewal: the playhead runs from the old end date to the new one.

receipts.title: Direction 3: the seal
receipts.commit: not merged · one switch selects it
receipts.what: A centred seal: a check inside a ring, with tick marks that sweep round once like the Timeline's ticks. The most classic "it worked" of the three. Device limit: a 3 / 3 gauge with an amber marker. Weakness: the closest to a generic success badge, and the three-arc ring on the device-limit version doesn't obviously read as one arc per device. Shows who it is licensed to and the updates date.

receipts_verdict: Decided 10 Nov: the updates timeline (Direction 2) for the activated receipt, the receipt with device tiles (Direction 1) for the device limit, and the notched tear line from Direction 1 added to the timeline receipt's middle divider. The agent is now combining them, carrying the design to the renewal, pending, working and failed receipts, and deleting Direction 3. The final pictures will be on the approval page.
